auth_plugins.description: Comma-delimited list of authentication plugins to load. Example: ["rest_auth/local", "rest_auth/jwt"]

data_parser_plugins.description: Comma-delimited list of data_parser plugins to load. Example: ["v0.0.42", "latest"]

debug_flags.description: Debug flags for slurmrestd. Overrides SLURM_DEBUG_FLAGS. Example: 'partition,jobstep'

group_id.description: Group ID to change to before processing client request. Leave empty to keep default group.

listen_addresses.description: List of host:port pairs or unix:/path/to/socket strings to listen on. Example: ["unix:/var/run/slurm/restd.sock", "0.0.0.0:6820"]

max_connections.description: Maximum number of connections to process at any one time.

openapi_plugins.description: Comma-delimited list of OpenAPI plugins to load. Example: ["slurmctld", "slurmdbd"]

security.description: Security functionality controls. Values: become_user, disable_unshare_files, disable_unshare_sysv, disable_user_check. Example: ["disable_user_check"]

slurm_conf.description: Path to the Slurm configuration file.

thread_count.description: Number of threads to use to process client connections.

user_id.description: User ID to change to before processing client request. Leave empty to keep default user.
